key_insight: vdW confinement in confined epitaxy does more than trap nuclei: it creates strong interfacial mechanical forces that significantly shape monolayer NbSe2 growth.
engineering_relevance: Designing the interfacial mechanics of the substrate stack could improve high-throughput synthesis of high-quality 2D materials.
method: AI-assisted DFT calculations of monolayer NbSe2 confined between c-plane sapphire and h-BN
Force-electronic landscape analysis to quantify atomic forces at the interface
Interfacial interaction energy estimation from computed force fields
evidence_signal: The abstract reports calculated forces of +0.070 eV/Å on Nb and -0.04 eV/Å on Se, with unit-cell interfacial interaction energy up to 2.4 eV.
watch_item: The conclusion is based on computational modeling, so experimental validation is still needed to confirm how broadly the mechanism applies in real growth systems.
paper_title: Resolving the interfacial mechanical landscape of monolayer NbSe2 grown by confined epitaxy
